input: Arrange a video call with my overseas siblings

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many siblings are involved and where they are located affects scheduling complexity and whether a group call platform is needed.
The time zones each sibling is in is the single biggest factor in finding a mutually workable call time.
Whether there is a specific deadline or urgency (e.g., a family occasion) determines how quickly this needs to be arranged.
The platform to use (Zoom, WhatsApp, FaceTime, etc.) depends on what everyone already has access to and is comfortable with.
Whether this is a casual catch-up or has a specific agenda (e.g., family decision, celebration) changes how structured the call needs to be.
The preferred method for coordinating availability (e.g., group chat, email, a scheduling tool like Doodle) affects how the user should reach out.
Knowing what a successful outcome looks like — a confirmed calendar invite, a set recurring call, or just an informal agreement — defines what 'done' means.

gold.taskTitle: Arrange a video call with overseas siblings
gold.taskDescription: Plan and set up a video call between the user and their siblings who are located in a different country or time zone.

questions.title: How many siblings need to join this call?
questions.description: Find out the total number of siblings involved, as this affects platform choice and scheduling complexity.

questions.title: Which countries or time zones are your siblings in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic spread to determine the overlap window for a mutually convenient call time.

questions.title: Is there a specific date or deadline driving this call?
questions.description: Understand whether there is urgency or a target date, such as a birthday, holiday, or family matter.

questions.title: Which video call platform does everyone already use?
questions.description: Determine the tool (e.g., Zoom, WhatsApp, FaceTime, Google Meet) that all siblings have access to and are comfortable with.

questions.title: Is this a casual catch-up or does it have a set agenda?
questions.description: Clarify whether the call is informal or needs structure, which affects how it should be prepared and communicated.

questions.title: How do you prefer to coordinate availability with your siblings?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants to use a group chat, email, a scheduling poll (e.g., Doodle), or direct calls to align on a time.

questions.title: What does a successful outcome look like to you?
questions.description: Determine whether success means a confirmed calendar invite sent to all, an informal agreement on a time, or a recurring call set up.
